title: Hosted demo HTTP contract (v0)
description: HTTP contract for the hosted demo v0. Nothing here is implemented. Session token header is X-Session-Token. Body cap is 8192 bytes. text maxLength is 7000 characters so an ASCII JSON wrapper fits in that cap; if the encoded body is still over 8192 bytes, 413 wins. max_len on state_view stays null: the floor run delivered 20019 characters with no in-graph truncation. D9 (decided 2026-11-04): a parser failure, a bootstrap provider failure, or a refused action that reaches the graph is a 200 with reply_text and turn incremented, as the floor run measured. The error envelope is only for requests that never reach the graph. counts_as_turn is const false on every envelope code because those codes never count; counted failures are not envelopes. Score is null until the stream 1 score function exists. provisional_slot is included because full_build_confirmation's build is not in team_draft.

locked.description: True only when role, species, ability, item, moveset, spread, and nature are all locked (state.all_locked).

send_text.description: Exact pending_input a button posts. Candidate rows use the 1-based ordinal ('1'), which classify_pending accepts. full_build_confirmation's accept button sends 'yes'. Build-option buttons send the option_id. completion_preference buttons send '1', '2', or '3'.

include_unlocked.description: Same comparison with lock flags ignored. Banner fuel. Not implemented in this follow-up; samples use null.

state_view_common.description: Shared projection. No API key, provider request, checkpoint, or raw graph state.

state_view_game.description: Game mode. round, turn, and score are present. They are omitted in sandbox, not sent as null.

state_view_sandbox.description: Sandbox mode. round, turn, and score are absent. Not null.

target_card.description: Display fields for the page. Not the legality blob and not the placeholder flag.

counts_as_turn.description: Always false. The envelope is not used for a result that reached the graph. Those are 200 message responses and the turn field shows the increment (D9).

message_response_game.description: 200 after the graph ran, including parser failure, bootstrap provider failure, and a refused action. turn is the incremented state turn (D9).

status_response.description: In-process progress. stage is an authored label while working or queued, never a graph node name. null when idle or when no label is known. queued means the message is waiting for a free graph turn; its stage is recommender/stage_labels.py QUEUED_STAGE. Both modes include turn here.

message_response_sandbox.description: 200 in sandbox. No top-level turn or score. The graph's own turn still advances inside the checkpoint; the page does not show it.

POST /session.description: 201. api_key is request-only. mode omitted means game. Before a session exists, one minimal provider call checks the key. A wrong key is 401 and costs no turn. The disclaimer says the demo makes this call. Game 201 includes target. Sandbox 201 does not.

POST /session/{token}/message.description: 200 if the graph ran: normal play, parser failure, bootstrap provider failure, or a refused action. turn increments (D9). 409 in_flight or stale_turn does not run the graph and does not count. 503 busy when the waiting queue is full: the message never reached the graph. text maxLength 7000. The byte cap is still 8192: 413 body_too_large wins when the encoded body exceeds it, including multi-byte text under the character cap. On timeout the API re-reads state turn before it answers, so a late checkpoint is not reported as uncounted.

POST /session/{token}/key.description: Same one minimal provider check as POST /session, then 200 replaces the in-memory parsers and keeps the game. Does not change turn. 401 unauthorized_key if that check fails: no turn, and the previous parsers stay. Example: transcripts/key_unauthorized.json.

POST /session/{token}/round.description: Game only. 200 starts round 2 on a fresh thread, turn 0. 409 round_in_flight while a message is running. Sandbox: 404 with an empty body and no error code. That is not hint_off and not session_not_found.

POST /session/{token}/hint.description: Game, round 1: 200, no turn. Game, round 2: 409 hint_off. Sandbox: 404 with an empty body and no error code.

GET /session/{token}/status.description: Both modes. The message handler sets working before the stream and idle in a finally, and updates stage from a node-start event. queued is the wait for a free graph turn, before working; stage is then QUEUED_STAGE. POST /key and POST /round do not change this record. It is lost on restart. Unknown token: 404 session_not_found, counts_as_turn false. Example: transcripts/status.json.

DELETE /session/{token}.description: 204 empty body. Drops parsers and the key.

status.description: Never reached the graph, envelope, counts_as_turn false: 401 unauthorized_key (POST /session, or POST /key with the previous parsers kept), 409 in_flight|stale_turn|round_in_flight|hint_off, 413 body_too_large, 415 unsupported_media_type, 429 rate_limited, 503 provider_unavailable|busy, 504 timeout. busy is POST /session/{token}/message when the waiting queue is full. Timeout re-reads state turn before answering. 404 session_not_found uses the envelope for an unknown token, including GET /session/{token}/status. Sandbox /round and /hint are a different 404: empty body, no code. 400 bad_request uses the envelope. Reached the graph: 200, turn incremented, no envelope.
